bracket.reading: 15 is inside the bracket: consistent with a mix where some WLAN cards take the C1PC/module route (no whole machine) and others do not. The Appendix 8-10 sits BELOW the floor of a 2-antenna / 2-WLAN-card project, so the Appendix cannot be the same reference scenario as J33. Neither value is reproducible from J33 alone.

breakdown_evidence.antenna_wlan_are: BUSINESS_COMPOSITION_DESCRIPTION - the note explains why RF certification consumes machines (antenna source x WLAN card matrix). It is not an executable calculation variable in the workbook: no cell formula consumes it.
breakdown_evidence.double_count_risk_if_added: HIGH - the Main Table per-SKU rate for RF certification is already the whole-machine count for that SKU; adding the J33 line items on top would count the same machines twice
breakdown_evidence.raw_text:
this data for 2 antenna source +2 wlan source refrence:
1.SRRC *2(PRC 型号核准);如果网卡数量大于天线数量，整机需求基于WLAN卡型号数量；
2.CE *4 =antenna *wlan（欧盟）,如果网卡数量大于天线数量，需额外提供网卡单体送测；
3.FCC(intel WLAN 数量*天线数量)*4（如果是C1PC ,就不需要整机）,其他wlan source(Non-intel) combine with CE.;
4.印尼* 2  .
5.Mexico *1.
6.资安*2（欧盟网络安全）

FULL.assumption: every numbered line item needs its own whole machines, FCC = intel_wlan x antenna x 4
